patches.name: Local server login
patches.description: Lets Roborock log in to your own Roborock Local Server instead of Roborock's cloud. Adds a server button to the login screen, where you enter the server's HTTPS address, email and PIN. Also turns off the app's signature check, which would otherwise close the re-signed app on launch. Needs a Roborock Local Server: github.com/Python-roborock/local_roborock_server.
